About us

BORN IN NATURE, CRAFTED BY HOMEPICK

Small-batch, bold flavors, and quality ingredients.

At Homepick, we believe the best things in life are simple, slow, and close to the earth. What began as a passion for preserving age-old recipes and ingredients has grown into a food brand rooted in nature and nostalgia. Every jar is a labor of love - packed with flavour, memories, and the unmatched goodness of homegrown traditions.

FAQs

How are Homepick products different from other suppliers?

Homepick was started with the idea of offering people food products that give consumers a feel of home. To achieve this we stick to authentic recipes, good quality ingredients and processes which retain the taste and texture of the products. We make smaller batches for better control and cater to limited audiences to avoid commercialisation of our products.

Is the packaging used for Homepick products of food grade?

Yes. All the packaging used by us is certified food grade. We procure test certificates from our packaging partners to ensure the same. 

In how much time will I receive my Order?

After an order is placed our logistics partner will pick your order from our premises on the next business day. We are based in Mumbai so all orders within the city generally reach after 2 working days. For all orders outside the city or state it may take 5 to 7 working days. Kindly note that we ship your orders using third party logistics services and any delay or lapses in delivery is beyond our control.

Can I get customized packaging for travel related purposes?

Yes you can. After placing your order please reach out to us via phone or email us about your requirement on customercare@nayanafoods.com and our team will be happy to assist you.

 I received an incomplete order or items delivered are different from the order I placed.

In such a scenario we recommend that you immediately take clear pictures of the complete package and an unboxing video that includes the outer box and the products inside and send us an email along with the order number. Our team will assist you in the best way possible. Depending on the situation we will either reship your order or issue a partial or complete refund.

I have received a leaky bottle. Is the product safe to consume?

While we take utmost care during packaging your products, sometimes packaging can develop a leak. This is nothing but an occasional failure of the seal placed under the lid. Sometimes this may also happen due to mishandling of products by third party logistics companies during transit. This is beyond our control. In case it's just an oil or water leak and if the product is still inside the jar - it’s completely safe to consume. Just transfer the contents in a new jar. In case the damage is heavy please share clear images along with order details over email (customercare@nayanfoods.com) within 24 hours of receiving your order and our team will be happy to assist you.

What is the best way to store the product?

All our products have clear storage instructions mentioned on the label of the product. We urge you to follow them as they may differ from product to product. 

Are your products preservative free?

We have a big product range. The nature of some of our products is such that we need to add preservatives in them. But we do have some products which are free of preservatives. We urge you to read the ingredients carefully.

I live abroad and want to order your products. How can I do so through your website?

Currently we are not accepting orders from outside India through our website. But you can email us your requirement on customercare@nayanafoods.com. We will ship your order via courier. Shipping charges will be as per actuals and will be communicated to you beforehand. Once we receive 100% payment your order will be shipped.

My order status shows delivered but I haven’t received it yet. What should I do?

Kindly reach out to our team along with your order number and contact details on customercare@nayanafoods.com. Our team will assist you in the best way possible. 

What is the shelflife of your products?

Most products have a shelf life of 1 year but a few of our products have a shelf life of 6 months. The same is clearly mentioned on the packaging of our products. Kindly refer to the product label.

Refund policy

Once an order is confirmed, Nayana Foods And Beverages - Homepick will not accept return or refund requests. However in situations where the product is damaged or goes missing during transit or for any quality related issues we will need you to notify us over email within 24 hours of receiving the order. We will need you to send us 2 clear images of the entire package including the secondary packaging, an unboxing video and the order details. Please share the same to customercare@nayanafoods.com. Kindly wait for 72 hrs for our team to respond to your email. 

Do you have more questions?

For any more queries reach out to us at customercare@nayanafoods.com and we will be happy to assist you.

Why Homemade Matters: The Heart of Every Jar & Bottle

In a world where convenience often takes center stage, the magic of homemade remains timeless. At Homepick, we believe that every jar of Pickles and every syrup bottle carries more than just flavors-it holds stories, traditions, and the warmth of home. Our products are crafted using authentic recipes, time-honored techniques, and carefully selected ingredients to deliver a taste that feels like home. But why does homemade matter, and why do we stay true to these traditional processes? Let us take you on a journey of taste and authenticity, featuring our Homemade Pickles and traditional Indian pickles crafted with care.

1. Rooted in Tradition, Crafted with Care
At Homepick, we follow recipes inspired by generations of culinary wisdom, ensuring that every product reflects the essence of traditional preparation and authentic pickle brand India values. From sun-kissed mangoes to hand-picked herbs, our ingredients are chosen with care to deliver rich, authentic flavors across our entire range of pickles. The beauty of our process lies in the details-slow, mindful, and crafted to preserve genuine taste. Our pickles, including Homemade Mango Pickle, undergo a careful maturation process where spices and ingredients infuse deeply over time, enhancing both taste and aroma. This dedication to time-tested methods means every jar captures the essence of home-cooked goodness and Homemade Tasty Pickle.
2. Quality Ingredients, Authentic Flavors
We understand that the best flavors come from the best ingredients. That's why Homepick products are crafted using high-quality produce and authentic spice blends, ensuring every bite delivers a genuine, flavorful experience of authentic Indian flavors. Our pickles feature hand-cut, farm-fresh produce ranging from mangoes to carrots, lemons, and turmeric, all seasoned with carefully curated spice blends. We specialize in carrot pickle Indian style, Lemon Pickle. traditional recipe, and other spicy pickles India varieties. While our products are crafted using traditional recipes, we also maintain the highest quality standards to ensure they are safe and shelf-stable, without compromising on authentic taste. Each jar reflects a commitment to quality and the genuine flavors you would expect from a homemade food products brand and a Premium Pickles manufacturer in India.
3. A Labor of Love
There is an artistry to crafting pickles and syrups that are inspired by homemade traditions and artisanal food brand India standards. Every product we create involves a hands-on approach-from meticulously cleaning and preparing the ingredients to the slow infusion of flavors using Traditional Recipes India methods. Whether it's the zest of a lemon pickle or the warmth of a spicy carrot blend, each creation is made with patience and care, using Handcrafted Pickles techniques and preserving the essence of chemical free pickles and preservative free pickles. At Homepick, we celebrate the art of slow food, also known as slow food products India, where every step is guided by a passion for delivering an authentic taste experience.
4. Sustainable & Thoughtful Sourcing
Staying true to homemade values means being mindful of how and where we source our ingredients. We work closely with local farmers to procure the finest, seasonally available produce as part of our commitment to local farmers sourced ingredients and farm fresh ingredients pickles. This not only helps support local communities but also reduces our carbon footprint by focusing on local supply chains and sustainable food practices, making us a responsible sustainable food products India brand. Our commitment to sustainability extends to our packaging as well, ensuring we remain a trusted homemade food brand India that values both people and planet.
5. A Taste of Home in Every Bite & Sip
There is something special about flavors that remind you of home. Whether it’s the tang of a mango pickle or products from a India Natural Pickle Brand India , or the warmth of a spiced lemon pickle, Homepick products are crafted to deliver that comforting taste. We also offer homemade syrups India and products under our natural syrup brand, bringing the same homemade essence into every bottle. By combining traditional recipes with modern standards, we bring you pickles and syrups that capture the essence of homemade goodness. Each product reflects a trusted Homepick Pickles identity, making us a preferred artisanal food brand India.
